name: zfmv_action_wait_begin
description: zFMV_ActionWait::Begin stores the supplied start time as a 32-bit float in the wait action's startSec field.
known_limits: The smoke covers Begin together with the paired wait Update behavior; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x462ed0 validates a thiscall leaf method that loads the double argument from the stack, stores it as a single-precision float at self+0x0c, and returns while popping the 8-byte argument.
The native smoke verifies Begin(10.25) stores startSec as 10.25f, then verifies the paired Update method keeps the action active before startSec + durationSec and stops at the boundary.
